title: WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions on Thursday, Sept. 10

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes are suspended in parts of Luzon on Thursday, September 10, amid heavy rains brought by the persistence of the southwest monsoon, locally known as habagat.
The following areas have announced class suspensions:

items: San Simon – no face-to-face classes; all levels; public and private (except Concepcion Integrated School); until Friday, Sept. 11
Sto. Tomas – no face-to-face classes; all levels; public and private (until Saturday, Sept. 12)
